title: Professional Certificate Course in The Pricing Practices and Market Failure
description: The course aims to provide students with an understanding of the role of prices in market economies and how pricing practices can contribute to market failure.
longDescription: Understand Price Discrimination & International Price Discrimination. Understand Transfer Pricing & Pricing in Practice Cost-Plus Pricing. Explore Different types of Pricing in Practice. Understand Capital Budgeting. Understand how to Evaluate Investment Projects. Understand Market failure and regulation. Understand Risk Analysis. The Pricing Practices and Market Failure course aims to provide students with an understanding of the role of prices in market economies and how pricing practices can contribute to market failure. The course examines the various factors that influence pricing decisions, such as market structure, consumer behaviour, and government policies. courseDetails: The course examines the various factors influencing pricing decisions, such as market structure, consumer behaviour, and government policies. Students will learn about different pricing strategies, including price discrimination, bundling, and dynamic pricing, and their implications for market outcomes. The course also covers the concept of market failure and the various market failures, including externalities, public goods, and asymmetric information.
